BiblicalUsage: Tokahath is the father of Shallum, whose wife Huldah was the prophetess. When the book of the law was found, Hilkiah and the king's men went to Huldah, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe, and they spoke to her.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name matters because of the woman beside it: Tokahath's son married the prophetess who told Josiah what the found book meant, and the family stands at the hinge of the reform. The King James spells the father's name Tikvath.
